slides.title: Our weekend club plan
slides.imageSource: Sergio Palao / ARASAAC (Government of Aragon), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

bubbles.text: Our school nature club meets every Friday. We usually read about animals in the library, but today we are planning a weekend trip. My cousin Maya is checking a map. We are going to stay in a tiny house near a forest. It has got a kitchen and two bedrooms.

slides.title: Our weekend club plan
slides.imageSource: Sergio Palao / ARASAAC (Government of Aragon), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

bubbles.text: There is a small restaurant next to it. We can walk by the lake and watch birds. Everyone has to bring a raincoat. I am packing a bottle of water and some sandwiches. We are excited, aren't we?
